text: Hey, Lukas. Got a minute? I was at the counter just now and heard your little story about the guy who missed an empty net from three meters. Was that supposed to be me?
No, Daniel, it wasn’t about you. It was about some Bundesliga guy from that viral video. If I wanted to talk about Sunday, I’d say it straight to your face.
Alright, if you say so. Just sounded pretty specific, considering what happened at our match. I’d rather you just say things directly if you’ve got something on your mind.

Look, I get why you’d think that, but I wasn’t even thinking about our match. If I had a problem, I wouldn’t go whispering about it behind your back. Next time, just ask before jumping to conclusions.
Fair enough, I can do that. I just wanted to clear it up, that’s all. Let’s leave it then. No hard feelings.
Glad we sorted it out. No hard feelings from me either. Do you want a drink or are you heading out?
I’ll take a drink if you’re offering, thanks. No reason to leave just yet. What are you having?
I’ve got a Helles right now. Want the same, or do you want something else? I’ll grab it from the bar.
